info.text:
Nvidia's co-founder is out. He owns 3.6% of it.
Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on Nov 12, 2026, after 33 years. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.
Nvidia also named its first-ever board chair, Harvey C. Jones. The stock fell about 4% Thursday.
Huang holds a 3.61% stake. The rest belongs to other shareholders, including the funds in many 401(k)s. Earnings are due Tuesday, Nov 17.
Sources: Nvidia press release (SEC 8-K); Reuters; CNBC.
News and education, not financial advice.
